reason: The README and repository metadata consistently describe a plugin whose user-facing purpose is scheduled, automatic switching of model routing to avoid peak-hour model pricing, with optional manual override, making its primary role automation of model selection behavior within DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中按配置的高峰时段自动切换模型，并在高峰结束后恢复默认模型，同时提供状态与手动控制入口。
summaries.en: This plugin automatically switches models in DeepSeek Harness during configured peak-hour windows and restores the normal model afterward, with manual status and control options.

capabilities: model route switching for both default and active session paths
manual status check and control via card/tools
live model/effort data lookup from llm service

reasons.code: README states this plugin auto-switches to an alternate model before DeepSeek peak hours and restores the official model afterwards.
Feature list includes scheduled switching using `leadMinutes`, support for multiple windows, and cross-midnight ranges like `22:00-02:00`.
It explicitly applies switching to `agentDefaultModel` and `apiProxy.sessions.selectModel` (next-turn effect for live sessions).
Repository metadata description labels it as "peak-hour model auto-switch" and topics include `model-switch` and `peak-avoidance`.
README describes manual UI card buttons plus model tools (`peak_avoidance_status` / `peak_avoidance_control`) and switch toast notifications.

capabilities: model route switching for both default and active session paths
manual status check and control via card/tools
live model/effort data lookup from llm service
